S.FORM: bzngah yasa qu pkaki' kya babaw kayal ka ttaypuq balay ru pyax, pyax smyax ktan. pnawngan pintkaykay' na nbkis sraral hya' qu bzngah qani hya' ga ramu' na wagi' ka wal bun na squliq maha ma. yalaw gi minsazing qu wagi' mru mkilux iayl qu kayal lmru, stu' naha' sa sazing mrkyas mlikuy musa' smbu' lma, nanu' bun naha' qu wagi' lga mprpus tay babaw kayal qu ramu' niya' lru yasa qu nyux ta' ktan ka bzngah qani la.
S.PHON: βzŋaħ ja[s|ɕ]a qu pkakiʔ kja βaβaw kajal ka ttajpuq βalaj ru pjax pjax [s|ɕ]mjax ktan pnawŋan pintkajkajʔ na nβki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]raral ħjaʔ qu βzŋaħ qani ħjaʔ ɣa ramuʔ na waɣiʔ ka wal βun na [s|ɕ]quliq maħa ma jalaw ɣi min[s|ɕ]aziŋ qu waɣiʔ mru mkilux iajl qu kajal lmru [s|ɕ]tuʔ naħaʔ [s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]aziŋ mrkja[s|ɕ] mlikuj mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]mβuʔ lma nanuʔ βun naħaʔ qu waɣiʔ lɣa mprpu[s|ɕ] taj βaβaw kajal qu ramuʔ nijaʔ lru ja[s|ɕ]a qu njux taʔ ktan ka βzŋaħ qani la
